headline: 40 days without salaries: household debts pile up and market sales decline
summary: Delayed salaries for some state employees have entered a 40th day amid a liquidity crisis. Rents, bills and debts are piling up while market activity declines.
why: Iraq's economy depends heavily on government spending and oil revenue, so salary delays signal fiscal and liquidity stress.
